slice: Slice 5 PR-B (frontend onboarding recomposition) round 2 verify
allowed_commands: from frontend/: npm run build, npx vitest run <spec>, npx eslint <files>, npx prettier --check <files>; git diff/log/show; NOT runnable here: npm run e2e, npm run check-contrast, full npm run test, dotnet test (record NOT_RUNNABLE_IN_SANDBOX with the error). The orchestrator has ALREADY re-measured the fixed tree and recorded, in docs/plans/split-ui-cycle/slice-5-evidence/pr-b/round1/orchestrator-runs.md (fix-round section): npm run build clean, npm run test 1037/1037, check-contrast 50/50, codegen:check 0, eslint and prettier clean on the touched files, Playwright 14 passed with the two pre-existing failures documented; treat those as measured fact.
lens_task: Lens: FIX VERIFICATION + MUTATION. HEAD is the fix-round commit; `git diff HEAD~1` is the fix round. Read .fix-brief.txt (the adjudicated fixes F1..Fn) and .stage-report.md (the fixer's claims). For each F1..Fn: confirm the fix is present (file:line) and effective by re-introducing the original bug as a temporary mutation where feasible and recording the observed red; one `mutations` entry per fix with observed RED (verified), GREEN (not effective), NOT_RUNNABLE_IN_SANDBOX (command to orchestrator_runs), or NOT_RUN (say why). List every fix in `conformance` as SATISFIED / PARTIAL / MISSING. Then a fresh pass over the fix-round diff for regressions the fixes introduced. Restore every file you mutate.
